name: Tactical Missile Corporation Joint Stock Company “Scientific Research Institute of Marine Heat Engineering”

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in April 2022 as “Tactical Missile Corporation Joint Stock Company “Scientific Research Institute of Marine Heat Engineering””, a unit of the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), which the US Treasury calls a large, state-owned Russian defence conglomerate.
It belongs to the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), a Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.

sources.title: Additions of Entities to the Entity List (87 FR 20295, 7 April 2022)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Sanctions Russia’s Defense-Industrial Base, the Russian Duma and Its Members, and Sberbank CEO (24 March 2022)

history.change: Record created from its listing on the US Entity List; not yet verified.
